summary.text: Geno Chiarelli (Eugene Chiarelli) is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates, representing District 78, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a substance abuse counselor by profession and has worked with child protective services in Marion County.

paragraphs.text: Chiarelli earned a bachelor's degree from West Virginia University in 2018 and has worked as a substance abuse counselor and with child protective services in Marion County.
He has represented District 78 since December 1, 2022.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Chiarelli said the opioid crisis should be the top focus of his campaign, and he described himself as a traditional conservative who is pro-life, pro-family, pro-worker and pro-gun.
